english: A box contains $n$ fair coins and one coin with a head on both faces. A coin is drawn at random from the box. A fair die is then rolled, and the drawn coin is tossed as many times as the number shown on the die. It is found that every toss shows a head. Given that the conditional probability that the drawn coin is the two-headed coin is $0.16$, the value of $n$ is ______.
hindi: एक डिब्बे में $n$ अनभिनत सिक्के तथा एक ऐसा सिक्का है जिसके दोनों फलकों पर चित है। डिब्बे से एक सिक्का यादृच्छया निकाला जाता है। फिर एक अनभिनत पासा फेंका जाता है, तथा निकाले गए सिक्के को उतनी बार उछाला जाता है जितनी संख्या पासे पर आती है। पाया जाता है कि प्रत्येक उछाल में चित आता है। दिया है कि निकाले गए सिक्के के दो-चित वाला सिक्का होने की सप्रतिबन्ध प्रायिकता $0.16$ है, तो $n$ का मान ______ है।
solution: Tree: coin (fair $\dfrac{n}{n+1}$, two-headed $\dfrac{1}{n+1}$), then die $k$ ($\dfrac{1}{6}$ each), then $k$ tosses
solution_full: Tree diagram. First level: the coin, two-headed with probability $\dfrac{1}{n+1}$ and fair with probability $\dfrac{n}{n+1}$. Second level: the die shows $k\in\{1,\dots,6\}$ with probability $\dfrac{1}{6}$ each. Third level: $k$ tosses.
Let $E$ be 'every toss shows a head'. Along a two-headed branch $E$ is certain, so $P(E\mid\text{two-headed})=1$. Along a fair branch with die value $k$, $P(E)=\dfrac{1}{2^{k}}$.
Law of total probability over the die: $P(E\mid\text{fair})=\dfrac{1}{6}\left(\dfrac{1}{2}+\dfrac{1}{4}+\dots+\dfrac{1}{64}\right)=\dfrac{1}{6}\cdot\dfrac{63}{64}=\dfrac{21}{128}$.
originality_note: New: the number of tosses is itself random (set by a die), so the likelihood of 'all heads' for a fair coin is a finite geometric average 21/128, and the posterior condition is inverted to find the number of fair coins (way 5: tree diagram, total probability over the die and Bayes linked). Closest known: 'a coin is chosen from n fair and one two-headed coin and tossed k times; all heads' (fixed k). Different because: the inner total probability over the die is required before Bayes can be applied, and the unknown is the composition of the box.

concept_use.Law of total probability: P(all heads | fair) = 21/128 is a law of total probability over the six die values.
concept_use.Bayes' theorem: The posterior 128/(128 + 21n) is Bayes' theorem and is set equal to 0.16.
concept_use.Probability via tree diagrams: The three-level tree (coin, die, tosses) organises the branches.
